## New in this release

### New
- With sync on, **favourite classes and teachers** now sync too: star one on your phone and it is a favourite on your other devices (and the web version) signed in with the same WebUntis account. Each account's favourites only go to that account's sync.

### Fixed
- Absences: "Partial · n of m lessons" counted a lesson twice when the timetable lists it more than once at the same time (e.g. a class split into groups). Lessons are now counted by their time.
- Absences: the "By subject" button now has its icon like the buttons next to it.

### Behind the scenes
- A server test that failed now and then (rate limit window rolling over) is reliable now.
